Diageo P L C (DEO) Stake Has Upped by Lvw Advisors Llc; Patten & Patten Increases Position in Cisco Systems (CSCO)
May 17, 2018 - By Marie Mckinney
Lvw Advisors Llc increased its stake in Diageo P L C (DEO) by 34.3% based on its latest 2017Q4 regulatory filing with the SEC. Lvw Advisors Llc bought 2,535 shares as the company’s stock declined 7.16% with the market. The institutional investor held 9,925 shares of the beverages (production and distribution) company at the end of 2017Q4, valued at $1.45M, up from 7,390 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Lvw Advisors Llc who had been investing in Diageo P L C for a number of months, seems to be bullish on the $90.20 billion market cap company. The stock increased 0.34% or $0.49 during the last trading session, reaching $146.28. About 396,720 shares traded. Diageo plc (NYSE:DEO) has risen 14.00% since May 17, 2017 and is uptrending. It has outperformed by 2.45% the S&P500.
Patten & Patten Inc increased its stake in Cisco Systems Inc. (CSCO) by 3.33% based on its latest 2017Q4 regulatory filing with the SEC. Patten & Patten Inc bought 9,415 shares as the company’s stock rose 10.71% while stock markets declined. The institutional investor held 291,905 shares of the technology company at the end of 2017Q4, valued at $11.18M, up from 282,490 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Patten & Patten Inc who had been investing in Cisco Systems Inc. for a number of months, seems to be bullish on the $209.37B market cap company. The stock decreased 3.76% or $1.7 during the last trading session, reaching $43.46. About 46.55M shares traded or 85.00% up from the average. Cisco Systems, Inc. (NASDAQ:CSCO) has risen 25.57% since May 17, 2017 and is uptrending. It has outperformed by 14.02% the S&P500.
